referenced-shortform-video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Clip and export referenced short-form videos from longer source content (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI up to 500MB).
- Automatic backend session setup and anonymous authentication for quick first-time use.
- Supports user prompts for clipping, editing, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Fast cloud GPU processing returns 1080p MP4 clips within 1–2 minutes.
- Supports multiple export formats and integrates error handling for file size/format, session, and credit issues.
- Designed for content creators and researchers needing shareable, referenced highlight clips.
